implementation.targetScope: React 19.3 Manager, Reference and Popper render-prop navigation components with explicit side placements, portals, RTL, offsets/arrows and bounded standard modifier options. Reuses independently implemented VPM Floating. Does not implement the generic usePopper hook, custom modifier engine, automatic placement or synchronous forceUpdate.

changes: Independent navigation wrapper over VPM Floating instead of another Popper geometry engine; no upstream wrapper runtime copied.
Stable callback refs and state equality preserve DOM/focus; React 19 ref cleanup and owner-document observer teardown are honored.
Async measurement results are accepted only for the newest active element pair; teardown suppresses queued updates.
Native resize observation repositions changed menus. A scaled clipping-container regression stays inside its visible boundary where the upstream control clips the menu.
Unsupported modifier callbacks fail explicitly rather than being silently ignored.
React 19.3 StrictMode positions the initial menu where the unchanged control leaves it at (0, 0); both outcomes are asserted separately.

caller.scope: FuseNavHorizontalGroup and FuseNavHorizontalCollapse use Manager, Reference and Popper render props, portalled into the root, with bottom-start/bottom-end/right/left placements and conditional open children. Other MUI @popperjs/core callers are not replaced by this package.
